# Legend (use on every page and sheet)

Overlap: Same / Similar / Different / Only in one exam / Not found
App coverage: Full (15 or more questions, proposed) / Partial (1-14) / Not yet (0)
Status: VERIFIED (checked against official document) / UNVERIFIED / NON-OFFICIAL (only non-official source)
Counting method for overlap: share of an exam's syllabus topics (rows) that also appear in CTET.
